key.name: default-terminal
key.description: The terminal which should be checked for first when performing an action which spawns a terminal window.

key.name: exported-app-labels
key.summary: Per-box menu label overrides for exported applications
key.description: Maps a box name to the label distrobox-export puts after an exported app's name in the host menu. Empty means the distrobox default, "(on <box>)".

key.name: profiles
key.description: Maps a profile name to the home directory boxes using it are given. A box with no profile uses the host's home, which is distrobox's default.
